scripts.dev: dotenvx run -- concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @mtkbwy/api" "npm run dev -w @mtkbwy/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mtkbwy/api && npm run build -w @mtkbwy/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @mtkbwy/api && npm run test -w @mtkbwy/web
scripts.docker:build:api: dotenvx run -- docker compose build api
scripts.docker:build:web: dotenvx run -- docker compose build web
scripts.docker:build: npm run docker:build:api && npm run docker:build:web
scripts.docker:up: npm run docker:build && npm run docker:start
scripts.docker:logs: dotenvx run -- docker compose logs -f api web
scripts.prisma:migrate: dotenvx run -- prisma migrate dev --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.prisma:deploy: dotenvx run -- prisma migrate deploy --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.precommit: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run sast
